written.summary: The child said they had to work with someone new yesterday and they had different ideas about how to organise the task so they had to talk it through a bit. The child mentioned the science thing, the group presentation, and that they were ellie and harry and then miss put daniel in as well. The child talked about the science room 12, a powerpoint about renewable energy that had to be five slides minimum but harry did nine for some reason. The child mentioned ellie was doing wind turbines and they were doing solar and then daniel started changing the font and made it comic sans and the titles were different sizes and it looked weird. The child said they couldn't concentrate because it kept changing and they were trying to read the slide and it was just distracting. The child told daniel to stop changing it until they finished the words and daniel said he was making it look better. Miss came over and said they needed to agree on one format so they picked arial again. Harry had put a picture of a coal power station on the solar slide and the child had to move it. The bell went and they saved it to the shared folder. The child said then you moved the picture and saved the presentation when the bell went yeah but it was the picture that took ages not the font thanks for correcting me.
